# Source of caves_ground_tiles.aseprite and .png (python tools/sprite/sprite.py build <this> <out.aseprite>).
# Recoloured from green_land/ground_tiles.png by tools/sprite/parts/area_ground.py, same layout (point a copy of
# green_land_tile_set's ground source at it). The cave floor: slate 3a4466 with a 5a6988 rim, block 1 slate 3a4466, pale sand = gravel 5a6988/8b9bb4,
# sand = cave dust 733e39/b86f50, red = amethyst veins 68386c, bog = dark pools 181425/262b44 (2026-11-24: a cool
# mid-tone slate for the Brood Cavern, the first level to use it, so the warm torchlight stands out; its LairLighting
# does the darkening)
size = 768x128
a = 181425
b = 1e2033
c = 262b44
d = 3a4466
e = 5a6988
f = 68386c
g = 733e39
h = 8b9bb4
i = b86f50
---
@IDLE 100
